reviews.note: The exemption applied to illness rather than money: a virus may be caught but will not last in the body.
A dated rapture claim, which rapture-any-time and pretrib-first-round both avoid being. Checkable at the end of 2028.
Adds the stated mechanism: ministers who started right fall because they look horizontally.
He rejects other ministers' 2040 or 2050 dates and offers soon instead, while saying he does not know what soon means. Sits against rapture-by-2028 given eleven days earlier.
His daughter's healing. A standing confession rather than a dated claim, and one that has been open since at least 2023.
The window closes and the outcome is credited to the audience's prayers over those hundred days.
The season detail is offered as evidence of precision and then cancelled by him in the same breath: Las Vegas is warm all year.

Peace called over Russia and Ukraine. Left unassigned rather than filed against war-season-2025-russia: it is the declaration against that claim, and the pairing is already carried by financial-storm-averted-prayer.
The fullest version of the defence: the October event did not arrive because 2 Chronicles 7:14 was satisfied and the land is being healed instead. The miss becomes the fulfilment.
Checkable in principle against the corpus, though drill baby drill was in wide political use well before 2024.
Holds both halves at once: a rocket taking off after 20 January and a great crash that was planned. He does not reconcile them.
Left uninterpreted by him, which is unusual and worth preserving as given.
Widens it past charismatics to all denominations, which makes it harder to score as confirmed by any single scandal.
Carries the 2 Chronicles 7:14 condition, which is the same clause that later retires the October call.
He tells the audience to be on guard that they may be listening to a false prophet. Kept because it sits directly against JKPqjW92sdc@2297 later in the same video.
Tells anyone who thinks he is off to keep it to themselves, 337 seconds after telling them to be on guard against false prophets. Both stand.
